root_cause: Avito request authority is distributed. Exact v1.0.43 RATE_LIMIT recovery creates COOLDOWN_SAME_ROUTE with probe_ip_changed=false, then can issue tabsReload/tabsUpdate and AVITO_RECOVERY_FRESH_DOCUMENT_REQUESTED without a common egress-permission gate.
historical_origin: v1.0.23 introduced verified egress/no-reload-without-proof locally; v1.0.28 added independent rate-limit retry semantics; the invariant was never promoted to a universal pre-request gate.
required_invariant: After a blocking network response, no intentional Avito network request may be issued until PROBES_COMPLETE proves probe_before and probe_after are known and different and the new egress epoch is newer than the blocked epoch.
green_expected_on_v144: HTTP_429 + probe_ip_changed=false -> AVITO_REQUEST_SUPPRESSED_NO_EGRESS_CHANGE; Avito network requests after block=0
